limits: All 132 default and 66 minimal existing Cargo cases match unchanged baselines. Each profile retains the existing ignored native metadata transaction gate and three empty doctest inventories.
Three unchanged standalone admission, location and profile cases execute. Installed boot, metadata transaction, image, mount, service and VM workflows remain separate required gates.

Tests execute uncached in the Linux sandbox without a Cargo executable. Command artifacts embed declared source-built EROFS, mount and package-runtime tools; the configuration library compiles without the command-tool repository.

Host deadline and rollout timestamp exceptions are function-scoped. EFI decoding uses checked even lengths and array chunks; conditional collapses preserve configuration-tree, retained-store and operator-id validation behavior. Two lookup-only metadata fixture maps use BTreeMap without changing request matching or config-drive priority. Test-only assertion exceptions preserve existing assertions. The retained module comparison accounts for moving one unchanged production helper before tests and two equivalent CPIO fixture padding predicates; three YAML fixtures match the frozen Cargo baselines.

The minimal Cargo editor oracle excludes optional dependency packages from automatic workspace membership, forwards --no-default-features to metadata/build-script checks, and removes only commands disabled by their required features. Before/after Cargo metadata checks preserve every other target. Source-catalog loading data retains three YAML fixtures without changing Rust ownership.
Selected editor diagnostics match; inference completeness, unselected diagnostics, aggregate-statistics comparability and diagnostic multiplicities are retained without claiming broader equivalence.

Compiled feature-unit sets match within each profile. Full compiler invocation and codegen-unit equivalence, performance acceptance, foreign/Wasm qualification, production cutover and Cargo removal remain separate work.

normalizations: The unchanged store-executable helper moves before the boot-platform test module.
Two CPIO fixture padding predicates use is_multiple_of with identical modulo semantics.
Four metadata trust-test path clones become borrowed one-element slices with unchanged assertion conditions.
The existing real HTTP timeout test gains a function-scoped clock lint exception.
